rationale: A third-party minor suffered bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's premises due to an icy walkway, establishing premises liability.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on your icy front walkway during an ice storm last week, sustaining a broken wrist. Parents are claiming medical bills. This is a high-severity pediatric injury liability claim requiring prompt investigation of premises maintenance and medical causation.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: child slipped and fell on icy walkway
